senses.gloss: ? nīḍaka, seems to represent corruptly a form of aneḍaka, q.v.: madhv iva nīḍakāt sravat MSV 〔i.270.19〕 (vs); surely corrupt; Tib. cited as sbraṅ rtsi ma bskol (= aneḍaka, see Mvy 〔5729〕) ro (taste, = rasa) lta bu (like); the last suggests rasa-vat, which would be unmetr. (end of śloka line).
